topics.title: Economic activities and hunting and gathering

concepts.learning_objective: Explain what primary activities are and why they depend directly on the environment.
Describe the features, regions and commercialisation of hunting and gathering.

topics.title: Pastoralism: nomadic herding and commercial livestock rearing

concepts.learning_objective: Describe pastoral nomadism, its animals, regions and reasons for decline.
Explain transhumance with examples from the Himalayas and the tundra.
Explain the organised, scientific and capital-intensive nature of commercial livestock ranching.
Describe slash and burn agriculture, its regional names and its problems.
Distinguish the two types of intensive subsistence agriculture of monsoon Asia.

topics.title: Plantation, extensive commercial grain and mixed farming

concepts.learning_objective: Identify the characteristics, crops and colonial origins of plantation agriculture.
Explain the features and regions of extensive commercial grain cultivation.
Describe the crops, livestock and practices of mixed farming.

topics.title: Dairy, Mediterranean agriculture, market gardening and factory farming

concepts.learning_objective: Explain the capital and labour needs, location and regions of commercial dairy farming.
Describe viticulture, citrus fruits and the winter advantage of Mediterranean agriculture.
Explain market gardening, truck farming and factory farming near urban markets.

topics.title: Farming organisation: co-operative and collective farming

concepts.learning_objective: Explain how co-operative farming works and where it has succeeded.
Describe the principle and working of collective farming (Kolkhoz) in the erstwhile Soviet Union.
Identify the physical and economic factors that decide the profitability of mining.
